name: Ukrainian TTS Verb Stress Paradigms
description: Full conjugation paradigms (infinitive, present/future, past, imperative, converb) with stress for Ukrainian verbs whose stress MOVES between forms (ходи́ти – хо́диш, писа́ти – пи́шеш, працюва́ти – працю́ю, дава́ти – даємо́) and for imperfective verbs that share their spelling with a perfective verb. Verbs whose stress never moves are listed in fixed_stress_lexicon.json.
verification: Every form was generated from the stress pattern and then cross-checked against the open ukrainian-word-stress dictionary (lang-uk, MIT; data derived from ULIF 'Словники України'). Forms the dictionary does not contain carry "attested": false.

stress_patterns.mobile: 2nd conjugation and mutating 1st conjugation (ходи́ти, писа́ти): infinitive, 1sg, past, imperative and perfective converb are stressed right after the stem; 2sg–3pl and the imperfective converb on the last stem syllable (ходжу́ – хо́диш – хо́дячи).
stress_patterns.ending: Stress on the ending in every form (коти́ти: кочу́, коти́ш, котимо́, котячи́).
stress_patterns.suffix-mobile: -ува́ти/-юва́ти verbs: infinitive and past on -ва́-; present, imperative and imperfective converb on -у́-/-ю́- (працюва́ти – працю́ю – працю́й).
stress_patterns.ending-mobile: -дава́ти/-става́ти/-знава́ти verbs: infinitive, past and imperative on -ва́-; present and converb on the ending (даю́, даємо́, даєте́, даючи́).
stress_patterns.fixed: Stress never moves; listed here only because the spelling is shared with a perfective verb.

notation.uppercase: Stressed vowel written as the only uppercase letter.
notation.slot: inf, 1sg..3pl (present for imperfective, future for perfective), past_m/past_f/past_n/past_pl, imp_2sg/imp_1pl/imp_2pl, conv.
notation.homograph: true when the same spelling has a different stress for another word or reading; disambiguate before applying.
notation.attested: false when the reference dictionary does not contain the form (rare impersonal or imperative forms).

matching.application: Look the token up by 'form'. Apply only when the lemma/aspect from your morphological analyser match, and skip forms marked homograph unless the analyser has resolved them.

status_values.seed: Initial entry, verified automatically; awaiting review by a linguist.
status_values.verified: Confirmed by at least two reviewers.
status_values.disputed: Normative sources disagree; MUST NOT be applied.
status_values.deprecated: Kept for traceability; MUST NOT be applied.
